mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% compresses equity valuations by increasing the risk-free rate, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% (based on 1990-2023 data).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 4.0%, SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases (based on 1990-2023 data).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) from prior month indicate broad economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and HOUST both decline from prior month
failure_condition: When INDPRO and HOUST both decline from prior month, SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances (based on 1990-2023 data).

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE >= 4.5%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals deepening economic contraction, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In high unemployment periods (UNRATE >= 4.5%), INDPRO declines are followed by positive SPX 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases (based on 1990-2023 data).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% immediately triggers short-term risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% (based on 1990-2023 data).

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP level above 11,000 billion dollars (2017 chained) indicates robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 > 11000, SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in less than 40% of cases (based on 1990-2023 data).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly employment level above 135 million persons signals a tight labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS > 135000, SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in less than 40% of cases (based on 1990-2023 data).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 200) and high interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) signals aggressive monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 200 and FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods (based on 1990-2023 data).
